faqItems.question: How long does standard delivery take?
faqItems.answer: Standard delivery typically takes 3 to 5 business days depending on your delivery pincode.

faqItems.question: Is tracking available for all shipments?
faqItems.answer: Yes, every order includes a SMS and Email tracking link active from dispatch.

faqItems.question: What happens if I am not available during delivery?
faqItems.answer: Our courier partner will attempt delivery up to 3 times or contact you via call.
